jem_summary: Give an Angler Fish an accepted shiny item and receive actual Night Vision.

pages.title: Light as a Favor
pages.text: Give an Angler Fish an accepted shiny item and receive actual Night Vision.

pages.title: Light as a Favor
pages.text: Permanent lamps and reef tiles furnish a dive base after the angler’s temporary assistance.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bring a gold nugget and find an Angler Fish; eligible fish can be bucketed. The real effect must activate; an unsuccessful interaction does not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The installed English localization describes feeding shiny items to an Angler Fish for Night Vision; it can be carried in a bucket. Possible noncombat animal-interaction quest.
